summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The State Street SPDR Global Dow ETF (DGT) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the The Global Dow index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of global blue-chip stocks selected by Dow Jones. DGT was launched on Sep 25, 2000 and is issued by State Street.

holdings.infoBox: DGT is an equity ETF with a total of 175 individual holdings. The top holdings are Palo Alto Networks stock at 0.79%, Advanced Micro Devices at 0.79%, Palantir Technologies at 0.75%, Meta Platforms at 0.74%, and Intel at 0.74%.
